Title: Database engine auditing for Azure Database for MySQL is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MySQL now provides general availability support for using audit logs to record database activity and events such as connections and queries. These logs are integrated with Azure Monitor diagnostic logs, enabling you to retain logs in Azure Storage, perform analysis with Azure Monitor Logs, and integrate with third-party tools via Event Hubs.

Learn more in the service-related documentation for Azure Database for MySQL.
